title: Burnaby Farm Tour map runs through Sept. 7

evidence.readerImpact: Lower Mainland readers can decide whether to use Burnaby's self-guided Big Bend farm route for a summer food, nursery, or local shopping outing before Sept. 7.
evidence.freshnessEvidence: The City of Burnaby lists the Farm Tour as running from May 1 to Sept. 7, 2026, and it remains active during the July 24 evening sweep.
evidence.uniqueAngleEvidence: Recent Trends Today Burnaby coverage includes art sessions, concerts, stewardship, Expo 86, and a mayor walk, but no Big Bend farm-tour or local farm-products guide.
evidence.sensitiveStoryGate: No crime, death, active emergency, private-person allegation, legal dispute coverage, or sponsored coverage is advanced.

commercialFitReason: The official Burnaby page creates local food, farm-products, nursery, garden, weekend outing, and neighbourhood retail intent that may fit standard contextual ads or future local sponsorships; article-level page views, Active View, RPM, ad revenue, and sponsor demand remain unavailable.
